why: Multiple post-snapshot papers prove the Farrell-Jones conjecture for new classes of groups, including a Bunke-Kasprowski-Winges result on lax monoidal finitary localising invariants (dropping the lax monoidal hypothesis), a paper proving the fibred FJC for suspensions of relatively hyperbolic and one-ended hyperbolic groups, and a 2026 Mathematische Annalen paper on automorphisms of relatively hyperbolic groups; the general conjecture itself remains open.

found.title: An improvement of the Farrell-Jones conjecture for localising invariants
found.note: Bunke-Kasprowski-Winges result extending FJC to lax monoidal finitary localising invariants; posting date on arXiv not confirmed, appears to precede or straddle snapshot.

found.title: Automorphisms of relatively hyperbolic groups and the Farrell–Jones conjecture
found.note: Mathematische Annalen paper (2026 issue) proving FJC for automorphism groups of certain relatively hyperbolic groups.

found.title: Survey on the Farrell-Jones Conjecture
found.note: July 2025 survey summarizing current status and recently proved cases of the conjecture.
